title: Cinematic portrait — lamplight on a weathered face
useCase: Character intro, documentary title card, casting board

anchor.subject: A weathered fisherman in his sixties, salt-stiff hair, pale eyes
anchor.scene: Dim cabin, single kerosene lamp on a table, rain-streaked window behind
anchor.motion: He lifts his eyes from the table to the lens and holds; smoke from the lamp drifts across
anchor.camera: Medium close-up at eyeline, locked, shallow depth of field
anchor.audio: Rain on glass, lamp wick hiss, no music
anchor.light: Warm practical from below-left, cold blue rim from the window

seedance-2.0.prompt: A weathered fisherman in his sixties with salt-stiff grey hair and pale eyes sits at a wooden table inside a dim cabin. He slowly lifts his eyes from the table to the camera and holds the look without smiling. A kerosene lamp on the table throws warm light from below-left across the deep lines of his face, while cold blue light from a rain-streaked window rims his hair and shoulder. Smoke from the lamp wick drifts across the beam. Medium close-up at eyeline, locked-off camera, shallow depth of field, 50mm equivalent. Documentary realism, natural skin texture, visible pores, subtle film grain. Keep his face shape and age identical across the shot. No subtitles, no watermark, no added light sources, no smiling.
seedance-2.0.notes: Name deliverable-faces and eye-colour; generic 'old man' produces a different person each generation.
